verdict.rationale: SigNoz is open source and self-hostable via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, so developers can run a local or dev instance [signoz-gh-1]. Community users confirm a docker-compose setup exists but call it heavy, with many services that need reconfiguring [signoz-comm-1, signoz-comm-4], and one user hit sh/bash dependency failures on Windows [signoz-comm-2]. Missing for 10: a lightweight single-container dev mode, first-party local quickstart docs in the pack, smooth Windows support, and hands-on evidence of testing instrumentation and dashboards against a local instance.
